articles.headline: Zelensky says over 10,000 Russian troops killed or wounded this week as Ukrainian military advances in Lyman sector
articles.excerpt: "The occupiers continue to be eliminated, and the designated objectives are being achieved," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

articles.headline: Ukrainian military delivers 4 tons of food to occupied Oleshky by drones, according to regional authorities
articles.excerpt: Kherson Oblast Governor Oleksandr Prokudin said Russian forces have attempted to disrupt the deliveries.

articles.headline: Ukraine sanctions 44 people involved in Russia's sham parliamentary elections in occupied territories
articles.excerpt: The elections were accompanied by "mass falsifications, forced voting, and predetermined turnout figures," Ukraine's presidential office said.

articles.headline: Russian attacks kill 14, injure 57 across Ukraine, with Odesa Oblast targeted in 'mass strike'
articles.excerpt: Overnight on Sept. 27, Russian forces launched 170 Shahed-type attack drones, Ukraine's Air Force said.

articles.headline: Russia's strike near Poland put Ukraine's railway lifeline in focus. But the bigger threat lies elsewhere
